verification_scope: Current native Windows review; current Linux/hosted/remoteCI/full benchmark were not verified.

isolated_existing.mode: built React app; intercepted API; isolated synthetic contexts

isolated_regressions.mode: built React app; intercepted API; isolated synthetic contexts

actual_http.mode: actual HTTP API and PostgreSQL; read-only domain operations; fixture sessions only

limitations: Airflow constraints inventory includes optional extras that are not necessarily installed; it is reported separately, never silently treated as the selected graph.
Exact-version advisory matching at query time is not proof of security, exploitability or deployment safety.
Installed snapshots describe their recorded interpreter/time; lock/platform differences remain explicit.
No dependency or advisory is suppressed/upgraded by this audit. Built-container OS packages, GitHub Actions runtime dependencies and future advisories are outside this package scan.

inventory_provenance.application-installed: Fresh inventory of current native application environment
inventory_provenance.dbt-installed: Fresh inventory of current native dbt environment
inventory_provenance.airflow-installed: Historical Linux Airflow installed inventory; fresh advisory query, not a new Linux installation or execution

limitations: Current Git index and unignored files only; deleted history, external services and binary contents are excluded.
Known-prefix and exact-generated-value checks are not an exhaustive secret detector. Values are never printed.

static_analysis.policy: Raw findings retained. Scoped review dispositions do not establish absence of vulnerabilities.

historical_v1.scope: Original reports retained; not a passing100k gate or current-source performance result.

failed_checks: alpha-operator exact API count and latest total
beta-operator exact API count and latest total

limitations: Synthetic local fixture evidence does not establish hosted readiness, customer effects or production reliability.
Optional Airflow constraints retain their disclosed advisories; zero required-graph matches is a separate scope.
Historical OS image scans retain nonzero/unfixed findings; application advisory counts do not erase them.
Automated accessibility scans and selected browser states do not establish complete WCAG conformance.
Future-v2 mocked/CPU regressions do not execute or promote a10k/100k performance matrix.

accessibility_review.scope: Representative computed DOM/CSS evidence; incomplete nodes/unmeasured states retained; no completeWCAGclaim

native_version_claim_race.scope: Test-generated current regression evidence; already included in the135test denominator.

ui_media.other_clips: Auxiliary captures; not selected as the primary actual-service demo.
